headline: Agility Robotics says it holds more than $300 million in multi-year humanoid robot orders, with the final value depending on milestones, as it prepares to go public through a merger.
score_reason: Company claim made in merger material, unverified and milestone-dependent; lowered by 1.
importance_line: Agility, maker of the Digit humanoid, is claiming real customer demand ahead of a stock listing, but the figure is its own and depends on milestones.
summary: Stock Titan, summarising company filings, reports that Agility Robotics cites more than $300 million in multi-year humanoid robot orders, with the value subject to milestones, ahead of a 6 Oct 2026 investor day for its proposed merger with Churchill Capital Corp XI. TradingView adds that the deal would bring in about $620 million and list the company as AGLT.
notes: Source set to AI News Desk because the entry is built from Stock Titan and TradingView summaries of SEC filings; neither page could be read in full. Stock Titan page returned 403 from this machine. Digit name taken from Agility headline in the same search (Robotics & Automation News).
